items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: the manager of the orchestra, Mr. Frank Minor was his name, he came over and he says

ctx.x: So I played and then while I was playing, he said, that's enough! So I walked off and about a few minutes later, the manager of the orchestra, Mr. Frank Minor was his name, he came over and he says, well, he says, uh, uh, Dr. Svisky has decided to let you join the orchestra again, but you must try to practice, you must try to improve. He says, he thinks you're doing very badly. And funny part of ours is that everybody else said that I was doing a real singing job, playing bass, you know. So I went through, oh,…
Did Hill, uh, let's see, did Heifetz ever play with you when you were there? Oh, in, in Indianapolis? Uh-huh.
